ideas.pitch: A Poisson regression and time-series forecasting dashboard predicting peak energy demand and infrastructure strain across North Carolina State University buildings using historical meter data.
ideas.title: NCState-Campus-Energy-Grid-Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven statistical forecasting pattern from the Apart Research AI Forecasting winner, applying hard domain modeling to local university utility data.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring platform that automatically flags unauthorized industrial land use and environmental compliance breaches in Wake County.
ideas.title: Wolfpack-Compliance-Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact technical architecture of the GeoNex-ATLAS runner-up by combining geospatial data APIs with computer vision models for automated auditing.

ideas.pitch: A localized no-code trading and automated dispatch platform enabling peer-to-peer solar energy credit sharing for North Carolina micro-communities using smart contracts.
ideas.title: Raleigh-Micro-Grid-Trading
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the automated agent execution mechanics seen in the ClashX trading platform with decentralized asset escrow.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent RAG student support platform tailored to NC State academic advising data, providing personalized curriculum planning and mental health resource triage.
ideas.title: Student-Wellbeing-Multiagent-Advisor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning multi-agent architecture and LangGraph orchestration framework used by the GreenNovation AI platform.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered anti-money laundering risk investigation platform utilizing graph intelligence and explainable gradient boosting models tailored for local credit unions.
ideas.title: Triangle-Fintech-Risk-Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the graph intelligence and explainable Focal LightGBM architecture that secured first place in the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.
